instruction: look at collision_drill.step. Plan drilling for the twelve candidate holes. Skip the two holes with holder collision risk near the 30 mm wall and post only the safe drilling operations. Tool definition: T1 is the drilling tool; use a holder length and collision settings that allow safe holes only. In the NC Program or post-process dialog, use metric units and the selected post processor for this setup, then export task-14.nc to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths.
